name: Maestro: Secret Sorcery
summary:
Step onto the pentagram and grab your Baguette Magique in "Secret Sorcery," the most occult Content Update for Maestro!

Conduct five legendary pieces, including the iconic Main Theme from the Harry Potter films, composed and conducted by John Williams.

Tracklist :

Williams — Hedwig’s Theme (From Harry Potter)
Dukas — The Sorcerer’s Apprentice (From Fantasia)
Grieg — In the Hall of the Mountain King
Berlioz — La symphonie fantastique
de Falla — El Amor Brujo

Discover The Coven, where Secret Sorcerers gather at night, and wield the Baguette Magique to the enchanting melodies of this magical selection.
